title: Bond-resolved AFM/AFS probing proton ordering in surface-confined benzimidazole assemblies
core_idea: Exploit bond-resolved atomic force microscopy and spectroscopy (br-AFM/AFS) to probe hydrogen-bond directionality and signatures of quantum proton behavior in surface-confined benzimidazole assemblies on Ag(111), combined with path-integral molecular dynamics to model nuclear quantum effects and correlated proton-transfer mechanisms.
tldr: Develop and apply br-AFM/AFS together with quantum simulations to detect, model and control proton ordering and nuclear quantum effects in cyclic hydrogen-bonded molecular architectures.
